The story

Made inside the feed. Suspicious of the feed.

Low Value Content is an editorial apparel project for people who participate in online culture while remaining unconvinced by what it rewards.

The premise

The machinery is showing.
We made it wearable.

Online life asks everyone to be visible, optimized, available, authentic on schedule, and endlessly measurable. The result is more content than anyone requested—and a few good shirts.

Who gets the joke

People who can see the interface behind the experience.

Professionals maintaining a public career narrative.

Creators who understand both the opportunity and the machinery.

Technology workers, chronic refreshers, and anyone who has called scrolling “research.”

The standard

Apparel first. Merchandise never.

Every line should land at a glance. Every design should feel intentional after the joke. Every final product should earn its claims through a physical sample.

See Drop 001

Content intoxication

Part warning. Part confession.

The play button in the cocktail glass is the signature: the feed is excessive, the effects are obvious, and we keep ordering another round.
